import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import numpy as np

# Load the data
customer_segments = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert categorical variables to numerical variables
le = LabelEncoder()
customer_segments['Education'] = le.fit_transform(customer_segments['Education'])
customer_segments['Marital_Status'] = le.fit_transform(customer_segments['Marital_Status'])

# Create a correlation matrix
corr_matrix = customer_segments.corr()

# Create a heatmap of the correlation matrix
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', square=True)
plt.title('Correlation Matrix of Customer Segments')
plt.xlabel('Features')
plt.ylabel('Features')
plt.xticks(np.arange(0, 29, 2), customer_segments.columns[1:], rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
